items.q: George also was with a large band featuring Red's first wife, Mildred Bailey.

ctx.x: many of his musical approaches as my own career continued. George and I first knew, after I followed him in Shaw's first big band, and I would find him at Nick's in the Village, in 1936, and he was with Bunny Berigan's first band, and one-nighters through New England, we had battles of music with them, and a battle of music in those days was two bands that was promoted by the ballroom, and the bookers, two bands in the same ballroom taking alternative sets, and let the people decide which band they liked best. I…

George also was with a large band featuring Red's first wife, Mildred Bailey. More battles of music in New England. I've saved Sidney Catlett until now, a prince among fellows. But a king on the drummer's throne - that was what we called and still do, a folding drum seat. A drum throne. Sidney, considered by many drummers, historians and critics, as the greatest jazz drummer. He was very close to being that. I always had reservations about calling anyone the 'greatest' anything. Because each individual has some…

We were playing a Command Performance for the Queen of England, and at the reception afterward, the Queen of England came up and said, "Mr. Rich, that was a wonderful performance -- how do you do it?" And Buddy, whose ego is not lacking, as we all know, at a loss for words, replied, "Just lucky I guess!"
